eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 该停就停
eyebrow.en: Local · no account · stop on time

headline.zh:
跑到该停就停
不再烧到预算见底
headline.en:
Stop where it should stop
not where the budget runs dry

sub.zh: 它把每一轮跑下来的测试增量对照花掉的成本，画成一条曲线，在收益开始变平时告诉你该停了——还能算出这一停省了多少。
sub.en: It plots each round's test gain against what it cost, marks the curve where returns flatten, and tells you to stop — and how much that stop saved.

title.zh: 跑到该停就停，不烧到预算见底
title.en: Stop where it should, not where the budget runs out

body.zh: 每一轮跑完，MargLedger 都会告诉你这一轮值不值。一旦连续几轮没有新的测试通过，直接建议你停下来，并算出这一停省下了多少——再也不靠硬截断，事后才发现后半程白烧。
body.en: After every round, MargLedger tells you whether it was worth it. The moment several rounds in a row add no new passing tests, it recommends you stop — and counts how much that stop saved. No more hard cutoffs you only learn were wasteful in the post-mortem.

title.zh: 一眼看清哪一轮开始不值
title.en: See exactly where value stops accruing

body.zh: 把每一轮的测试增量对照它花掉的成本，画成一条曲线，并在收益开始变平的地方标出拐点。整条循环花了多少、换回多少，一条曲线讲清楚。
body.en: It plots each round's test gain against what it cost as a single curve and marks the knee where returns start to flatten. How much the whole loop spent and what it earned back — one curve, the whole story.

title.zh: 价值用测试说话，不是黑盒打分
title.en: Value measured by tests, not a black-box score

body.zh: 每一轮的“价值”就是这轮新跑过的测试增量——机器可校验的真值，不是模型自己给的分数。只有跑测试的编码循环才成立；没有测试套件的场景，我们明说不在范围，不假装能打分。
body.en: Each round's “value” is the new tests it got passing — a machine-checkable ground truth, not a score the model hands itself. That only holds for coding loops that run tests; for anything without a test suite, we say outright it's out of scope, rather than pretending to score it.

title.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 一条命令

body.zh: 一条 uv 命令装好，读你本机的循环记录来分析，不上云、不注册、不外发数据。中英双语 README，MIT 开源。
body.en: Install with one uv command and analyze the loop records already on your machine — no cloud, no sign-up, nothing sent out. Bilingual README, MIT open source.

headline.zh: 把“这一轮到底值不值”做成有据可查的结论
headline.en: Turn “was this round worth it?” into a grounded verdict

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、无付费墙。本地运行、读本地记录这一核心动作，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, no paywall. Running locally and reading your own records is never gated.

tag.zh: 在收益递减处叫停 agent 循环
tag.en: Stop agent loops at diminishing returns
